content: i18n architecture mistakes: hardcoded strings creep in when no lint rule enforces translation-function wrapping from day one. Common mistake: concatenating number/date + string directly instead of using ICU MessageFormat placeholders inside the translation string - breaks word order and pluralization in other languages. Naive plural handling (if count===1) fails for languages with more than 2 plural forms; ICU plural syntax (react-intl/FormatJS or i18next ICU plugin) required. French-specific: French plural rule differs from English at 0/1 boundary (0 is grammatically singular in French), and gendered adjectives need distinct message keys or ICU select formatting. Recommendation: pick FormatJS/react-intl or i18next+ICU before writing UI copy, wrap every string through translation function from the first component, route dates/numbers/currency through Intl.NumberFormat/DateTimeFormat with app locale (needed for DZD + Algerian conventions).
